style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE tadpole shrimp, triops, broad brown head shield, long forked tail, many legs; cartoon mouth at the front of the shield; same animal
second_characters: water beetles in neckties, huge at the lens

props.coins: blank coins, no markings, thrown and caught
props.weight: ONE black iron weight, handed to him
props.clutch: a clutch of eggs, pushed into the silt

environment: a drying clay puddle at noon, a dense reed wall close behind him, cracked clay shelf, glare on the shallow water
lighting: flat white daylight from above, cyan rim left, warm amber kick right, sparkle on the ripples
motion_rule: the camera orbits the hero and never stops, a full circle by 10.00: reeds, clay and glare sweep behind him edge to edge every beat. New shot size every beat, medium to close. Beetles rush INTO the lens every beat. One hero action per beat: he throws his body the full frame width, filling half the frame height, shield and mouth to the lens.

audio.rate: 3.5 syllables per second, each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, speech ends by 6.75, then water and reeds
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opens on every syllable, empty while speaking, props held by the legs

timeline.a: already thrashing across the lens in a finger deep puddle, coins sliding off his shield; a beetle catches one at the glass
rakes a heap of coins to himself the full width, legs churning; two beetles tumble over the lens
flings the coins up with both legs, body twisting after them; beetles leap at the glass to catch them
whips the other way against the orbit, tail sweeping edge to edge; a beetle climbs the lens with the weight
drives across the frame through the shallows, water bursting; beetles pour over the lens
takes the iron weight from two beetles on the move, holding it up at the lens; the puddle drops
swings the weight the full width, cracked clay showing behind; beetles scatter into the lens
scrapes a hollow in the silt, shield to the lens, and rolls the clutch of eggs into it; a beetle shovels beside him
plants the weight down on top of the clutch, legs braced, mouth to the lens; beetles scatter from under it
pats the silt flat over it with both legs and throws his shield into the lens; a beetle hangs a necktie on the weight
the water is down to a film, he thrashes the last of it across the frame, tail whipping; beetles skid past the lens
beetles haul him by the tail out of the drying puddle, legs still running in the air, shield turned to the lens
he throws his head and shield into the lens, mouth filling the frame; behind him the weight stands alone on the flat silt

must_appear: at 0.00 already thrashing in a finger deep puddle, coins sliding off his shield; coins flung up at 1.60; the weight taken at 4.05; the clutch rolled into the silt at 5.55; the weight planted on it at 6.75; the weight alone on the silt in the last beat
negative_prompt: printed words, digits, Cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, black bars, night, dark scene, murky water, a prop held still and worked in place, a hero running at the camera on his feet, hero riding anything, a moving belt or cart, parked camera, push in, motionless background, empty background, wide shot, view from behind, lowered head during speech, still last second, speech after 6.75, English speech, a second triops
